mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing character-action typography module carousel. Lock one original clearly adult performer with face, hair, costume and handheld-prop anchors. Rotate at least four original short-word modules; each word may orbit, enlarge, split or become a stage plane only when one corresponding performance action drives that change. Keep type readable and let foreground/background crossings test but never erase adult identity. End with the same performer and one original short mark. Do not copy the source performer, wording, fashion styling, microphone, typography, layouts or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult performer with at least four stable identity and prop anchors.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unstable anchors turn modules into different performers.

invariants.rule: Use one new original short word and one corresponding performance action per module.
invariants.ablation_failure: Several words per action create noise.

invariants.rule: Allow type to cross foreground and background but never fully erase the adult face and body identity.
invariants.ablation_failure: Full coverage becomes a hidden character swap.

invariants.rule: Repeat prop, palette and stage axis while word geometry changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated cards lose the carousel system.

invariants.rule: End with the same adult and one original short mark in a still composition.
invariants.ablation_failure: A moving word cloud has no closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source pink-haired adult performer, face, makeup, outfit and microphone
source words including SEXY, CUTE, BAD GIRL, BIG TROUBLE and other visible phrases
source helix bands, typefaces, colors and exact word layouts
source gestures, expressions, poses and timing
source MiniMax H3 wording, creator identity and camera path
